title: WaterSound "High Tide" 260 Gulf Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Located in the Peninsula of WaterSound- Short walk or bike ride to the beach- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- 3 adult bikes- Outdoor kitchen- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDetails: Dive into a delightful getaway at High Tide, a beautiful 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home that sleeps 6 guests. Tucked within the Peninsula of WaterSound, this property boasts a quiet location, a spacious patio, an outdoor kitchen, and beach access a short bike ride or walk away! Relish sunlit days of meandering strolls down the boardwalks, sunbathing on the white-sand beach, and visiting The Big Chill for live music and delicious dining.Lush foliage and swaying palm trees welcome guests to this 2-story home. Follow the front steps past the shaded porch and step inside to find rich hardwood floors and soaring ceilings. Sink into the plush white couch or loveseat and enjoy a restful afternoon reading in the sunlight. Along the side of the room, a TV provides entertainment. The space continues into a dining area with a table for 6, beneath artistic pendant lights, where guests can enjoy intimate dinners or casual lunches. Around the corner, the gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream with high-end appliances, elevated finishes, and a spacious island that doubles as a 3-stool breakfast bar—perfect for hosting mini sous chefs and friends. Out the back door, discover the sprawling brick-paved patio. Fire up the grill at the built-in outdoor kitchen for a tasty barbecue dinner at the 4-seat table. Retire to either of the 2 guest bedrooms, each with a queen bed and a private bathroom.A steel-and-wood staircase leads to the second-level primary bedroom, boasting an inviting king bed made for unwinding, a private bathroom, and access to a covered balcony—wake to fresh air and flourishing fauna!Savor a classic beach vacation full of charm and treasured memories at High Tide in WaterSound. Parking for 3 vehicles, plus 3 complimentary adult bikes, make it easy to explore nearby 30A attractions, including The Big Chill, Seacrest Beach, and Deer Lake State Park. For beach access, follow the boardwalks throughout the community. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 7):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Daybed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.*This home is pet-friendly, up to 2 dogs, with an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA and community fines.*Access to the Watersound Beach Club is not included.*Watersound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors.*This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.

Tucked within the Peninsula of WaterSound, this property boasts a quiet location, a spacious patio, an outdoor kitchen, and beach access a short bike ride or walk away! Relish sunlit days of meandering strolls down the boardwalks, sunbathing on the white-sand beach, and visiting The Big Chill for live music and delicious dining. Lush foliage and swaying palm trees welcome guests to this 2-story home. Follow the front steps past the shaded porch and step inside to find rich hardwood floors and soaring ceilings. The space continues into a dining area with a table for 6, beneath artistic pendant lights, where guests can enjoy intimate dinners or casual lunches. Around the corner, the gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream with high-end appliances, elevated finishes, and a spacious island that doubles as a 3-stool breakfast bar—perfect for hosting mini sous chefs and friends. Out the back door, discover the sprawling brick-paved patio. Fire up the grill at the built-in outdoor kitchen for a tasty barbecue dinner at the 4-seat table. Retire to either of the 2 guest bedrooms, each with a queen bed and a private bathroom. A steel-and-wood staircase leads to the second-level primary bedroom, boasting an inviting king bed made for unwinding, a private bathroom, and access to a covered balcony—wake to fresh air and flourishing fauna! Savor a classic beach vacation full of charm and treasured memories at High Tide in WaterSound. Parking for 3 vehicles, plus 3 complimentary adult bikes, make it easy to explore nearby 30A attractions, including The Big Chill, Seacrest Beach, and Deer Lake State Park. For beach access, follow the boardwalks throughout the community. Book today!
